title: About
text:
Introductions by Jimmy Yu

About Me
Hi, I’m Jimmy Yu. I’m a junior from the University of Richmond in the United States, and my major is Business. In my free time I love playing tennis and pickleball, and I also enjoy playing video games. My favorite singer is Jay Chou. I’m looking forward to working with this team!


Seymen Kizilkaya
Seymen is from Turkey and lives in Germany. He studies Economics at a university in Switzerland. He loves watching anime and football, and his favorite club is FC Barcelona.


Subham Pradhan
Subham is from India and is studying International Affairs. He loves trying all kinds of different sports, and lately he has been learning judo and tai chi. He also works very hard at learning Chinese, and sometimes we even chat with each other in Chinese.

title: About
text:
Introductions by Subham Pradhan

About Me
Hi, I’m Subham Pradhan. I’m from India and study International Affairs. I enjoy trying new things, exploring different cultures, and trying all kinds of sports. I love talking with people and am always up for a conversation about history, politics, or our favourite shows. I enjoy anime, K-dramas, Hollywood films, and Bollywood movies and series. Lately, I’ve also been watching Chinese dramas and reading manga and manhwa. Naruto is my favourite anime.


My Team

Jimmy Yu
Jimmy is from China and is a junior at the University of Richmond in the United States, where he studies Business. He enjoys tennis, pickleball, and video games. I love dancing and going to parties with him. He also helps me with my Chinese studies. We often practise conversations in Mandarin, which helps me prepare for my Mandarin exams. We enjoy going to the movies and hanging out together, too.


Seymen Kizilkaya
Seymen is Turkish, lives in Germany, and studies economics in Switzerland. He is kind, helpful, and always there for our group. He loves spending time with his friends and is always ready to join in different activities and events. He also helps me learn more about his culture. Seymen is one of the first people I’ve met who is truly passionate about Bollywood: he loves Indian films, often hums Indian songs, and enjoys talking about Indian movies. He also enjoys cooking, playing the piano, and football.
